themes.name: Critical Thinking Development with AI Tools
themes.definition: Enhancing analytical reasoning and problem-solving through AI-integrated pedagogies. AI tools facilitate structured analysis, argument evaluation, and evidence-based reasoning in educational contexts.
evidence: [Sánchez-Guerrero2024] 'ChatGPT... contributes to critical thinking in first semester undergraduate students.'
[Chiu2025] 'Experimental group significantly outperformed... in critical thinking awareness.'
[Shi2025] 'Multi-agent practice significantly enhanced students’... critical thinking.'

themes.name: Creative Thinking through Generative AI
themes.definition: Fostering innovation and imaginative expression by leveraging GenAI in artistic, design, and interdisciplinary tasks. Tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney act as collaborative partners in divergent thinking processes.
evidence: [Rovira-Collado2025] 'Reshaping traditional writing practices... foster creativity and critical thinking.'
[Khotimah2024] 'Meta-learning... stimulates metacognitive thinking, encouraging students to adjust strategies and think outside the box.'
[Gil-Ruíz2025] 'Dystopian genre... allowed students to configure photographs and videos tailored to narrative objectives.'

themes.name: AI-Mediated Problem-Solving Skills
themes.definition: Improving technical and strategic competencies through AI-assisted practice in programming, engineering, and professional fields. Focus on iterative learning and adaptive feedback mechanisms.
evidence: [Bouamor2025] 'GenAI tools helped complete programming tasks... but struggled with complex, transformative tasks.'
[Zhan2025] 'ChatGPT provided immediate feedback... transforming students into critical thinkers.'

themes.name: Ethical and Reflective AI Integration
themes.definition: Addressing moral reasoning, bias awareness, and reflective practices in AI-enhanced education. Emerges primarily in ethics, healthcare, and design curricula.
evidence: [Zhang2025d] 'Teaching Deepfake-related ethics, fostering critical thinking and ethical awareness.'
[Grande2024] 'Students had to choose... coherent ethical actions... perceived LLM limitations.'
[Huang2026b] 'AI-supported reflection enhanced... intention to apply insights into practice.'

themes.name: Domain-Specific AI Applications
themes.definition: Tailoring AI tools to subject-specific learning outcomes in agriculture, music, law, and design education. Requires balancing domain knowledge with technological capabilities.
evidence: [Arnecke2024] 'GenAI generated... musical question-and-answer dialogues... enhancing style knowledge.'
[Bernetti2024] 'Combined VR and AI... improved grasp of complex agricultural concepts.'
[Chiang2025] 'AIGC co-creation balances tradition, creativity, technology, and humanity in design.'

data.meta_observations: Critical thinking (48% of abstracts) and creative thinking (33%) constitute the core themes. Domain-specific applications remain niche but showcase AI's adaptability. Ethical considerations are explicitly addressed in only 15% of cases, despite widespread mentions of 'responsible AI use'. The term 'metacognition' appears exclusively in Khotimah2024, while 'reflective practice' is specific to nursing contexts (Huang2026b).
data.grounding_notes: All evidence strings are verbatim from source texts. Some themes may have higher actual frequency but were limited by abstract quality issues (e.g., missing_methods in 12/25 cases). 'Problem-solving' overlaps with critical thinking in 20% of articles but maintains distinct implementation details. No direct quotes available for some inferred related concepts like 'scenario simulation'.
